card.text: Young Sun-like star 17 parsecs away whose magnetic field was mapped 18 times over three years.

sources.label: Alvarado-Gómez et al. 2025
sources.quote: the technique of Zeeman-Doppler Imaging (ZDI) was used to reconstruct 18 maps of the large-scale surface magnetic field of the star

introduction.text: ι Horologii is a star like the young Sun, about 600 million years old. Mapped 18 times over three years, its magnetic field flips polarity roughly every two years.

sources.label: Alvarado-Gómez et al. 2025
sources.quote: determining a magnetic polarity reversal timescale of roughly 100 rotations (~773 d)
